changelog: Modernize for current AsusWRT/AsusWRT-Merlin: add firmware/system diagnostics, Ethernet port status, OpenVPN/WireGuard/VPN client status, alert-friendly health bundle, raw AsusData dumps for newer firmware features, HTTPS port config, and client sorting for top talkers or signal checks.
summary: Monitor and manage Asus routers running AsusWRT/AsusWRT-Merlin firmware. Supports status checks, client/top-talker lists, presence detection, AiMesh topology...
